gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Alumni Sans SC has oversized lowercase and a squeezed fit, with stems just heavier than its hairlines. Wallpoet's bold, high-rising display letters sit above it, and a longer read stays compact and contemporary.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anaheim: Anaheim packs its rounded, open-sided glyphs into a dense huddle the eye slides right through. Wallpoet commands the heading, though shrinking it would lose its bold, high-rising presence beside that sans-serif.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-arsenal: Arsenal sets its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, with a close-knit string of letters and a modest weight shift. Wallpoet's bold display heading above it keeps a longer read approachable.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-arsenal-sc: Crisp and compact, Arsenal SC carries soft shifts in thickness that never turn stark, with tight fit and wide mouths. Wallpoet's bold, commanding display letters above it make the two feel like loud and quiet.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-asimovian: Asimovian builds tall lowercase from a single stroke width, approachable and neutral as a sans-serif. And Wallpoet, bold and commanding with its see-through line, takes the heading above it.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-basic: Wallpoet's letters have a line where the paper shows through. Basic follows with a gentle bump from small letters up to capitals, so a longer read feels clean and professional.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-cal-sans: Stout letters, one stroke width throughout. Cal Sans has a tall x-height and short ascenders, so a longer read feels modern and approachable under Wallpoet's bold, commanding display heading.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-carlito: Carlito has open round letters, tight spacing like thread wound on a spool, and small-looking capitals beside big lowercase. Under Wallpoet's heading, a longer read stays modern.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-changa: Wallpoet's smooth bends and the paper showing through between its letters make a bold, commanding heading, while Changa gives lowercase the stature of cast iron capitals. Try a modest heading size.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-courier-prime: Wallpoet takes the heading with a bold, commanding display look, while Courier Prime fills most of the height with the steady line of a technical drafting pen. A longer read stays precise and structured.
